import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;

    static class Edge {
        int v, rev;
        long flow, cap, cost;
        
        Edge(int v, int rev, long flow, long cap, long cost) {
            this.v = v;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static List<List<Edge>> adj;
    static boolean[] visited;
    static int[] parent;
    static long[] potential;
    static long[] distance;

    static void init_graph(int n) {
        adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        visited = new boolean[n];
        parent = new int[n];
        potential = new long[n];
        distance = new long[n];
    }

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, long capacity, long cost) {
        adj.get(a).add(new Edge(b, adj.get(b).size(), 0, capacity, cost));
        adj.get(b).add(new Edge(a, adj.get(a).size() - 1, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static long min_cost_flow(int source, int sink, long[] total_cost, int n, boolean sparse, long lower_bound) {
        Arrays.fill(visited, false);
        Arrays.fill(distance, INF);
        distance[source] = 0;

        if (sparse) {
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(x -> x[0]));
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, source});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] cur = pq.poll();
                long d = cur[0];
                int u = (int) cur[1];
                if (visited[u]) continue;
                visited[u] = true;
                for (Edge e : adj.get(u)) {
                    if (e.flow <= e.cap - lower_bound && distance[e.v] > distance[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.v] + e.cost) {
                        distance[e.v] = distance[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.v] + e.cost;
                        parent[e.v] = e.rev;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{distance[e.v], e.v});
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int iter = 0; iter < n; iter++) {
                int u = -1;
                long best = INF;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (!visited[i] && distance[i] < best) {
                        best = distance[i];
                        u = i;
                    }
                }
                if (u == -1) break;
                visited[u] = true;
                for (Edge e : adj.get(u)) {
                    if (e.flow <= e.cap - lower_bound && distance[e.v] > distance[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.v] + e.cost) {
                        distance[e.v] = distance[u] + potential[u] - potential[e.v] + e.cost;
                        parent[e.v] = e.rev;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (distance[sink] >= INF) return 0;

        long df = INF;
        for (int u = sink; u != source; ) {
            Edge e = adj.get(u).get(parent[u]);
            df = Math.min(df, adj.get(e.v).get(e.rev).cap - adj.get(e.v).get(e.rev).flow);
            u = e.v;
        }

        for (int u = sink; u != source; ) {
            Edge e = adj.get(u).get(parent[u]);
            Edge rev = adj.get(e.v).get(e.rev);
            rev.flow += df;
            e.flow -= df;
            total_cost[0] += df * rev.cost;
            u = e.v;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (distance[i] < INF)
                potential[i] += distance[i];
        }
        return df;
    }

    static long min_cost_flow_full(int source, int sink, long[] total_cost, int n) {
        Arrays.fill(potential, 0);
        long total_flow = 0;
        total_cost[0] = 0;

        for (long lb = 1L << 30; lb > 0; lb >>= 1) {
            while (true) {
                long df = min_cost_flow(source, sink, total_cost, n, true, lb);
                if (df == 0) break;
                total_flow += df;
            }
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        final int source = 0;
        final int sink = n * T + 1;
        int graph_size = sink + 1;

        init_graph(graph_size);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            int b = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, (long) cost * d + c);
                    add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, (long) cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = {0};
        long flow = min_cost_flow_full(source, sink, price, graph_size);
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
